title: Model target: 23 systems by 7 capabilities
rules: One honest record: the pane, the build tracker and the Master Board read this file; the counts are computed, never stored.
Evidence lists the files that implement a cell (paths from the repo root); empty when nothing is built.
Tested in Revit only after a passing check on a real model by a person or an unattended scenario.

capabilities.name: Enrich
capabilities.meaning: Fill the kit's data on the model's elements (loads, ratings, flows, marks) so the other steps have facts to work from

capabilities.name: Size
capabilities.meaning: Propose sizes (cables, breakers, pipes, ducts, plant) as drafts from the facts; the engineer decides

capabilities.name: Diagram
capabilities.meaning: Draw the system's line diagram (single-line, riser or schematic) from the model, values from the model only

capabilities.name: Calculate
capabilities.meaning: Run the kit's calculation for the system on the model's facts and write a calc sheet with TBC where data is missing

capabilities.name: Review
capabilities.meaning: Check the model and the calculation results read-only and list what is wrong or missing for the engineer

capabilities.name: Quantities
capabilities.meaning: Schedules and quantities from the model that feed the BoQ and procurement

capabilities.name: Document
capabilities.meaning: Sheets from the Sheet Register (diagrams, schedules, calc summaries) ready to issue
